dedupe_keys.name: aimsun next transport modelling and simulation software

description: Aimsun Next is a commercial transport modelling and simulation application from Aimsun, a Barcelona company with nearly 30 years of experience in transport planning and operations software. In one project document it offers importing and editing a transport network, estimating and refining travel demand, and simulating movement in static macroscopic assignments or in dynamic mesoscopic, microscopic or hybrid simulation, with route choice from all-or-nothing methods to dynamic user equilibrium; outputs range from 3D animation to transport analyses, and a scenario manager handles a base model and option tests. It has calibration and validation tools, scripting, an API and an SDK, and version 26.0.0 is current with an online user manual. Related products are Aimsun Start, a pre-built model powered by TomTom data, Aimsun Live for real-time traffic management as a digital twin, and traffic data services. It is generic and used worldwide on any road and transit network. Access is by paid licence. Caveats: it is proprietary, so model internals are documented but not open, and results depend on the demand and network data supplied. It supports network flow, capacity planning and incident and disruption studies of road and transit networks, and is related to the open SUMO and MATSim simulators.
